record.question: 'Kwangmyongsong' is a satellite name of
record.explanation: Answer D: North Korea. Kwangmyongsong is a North Korean satellite series/name. The DPRK's original 2016 registration lodged with the UN identifies Kwangmyongsong-4 and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea as launching state. Reference: https://www.unoosa.org/res/osoindex/data/documents/kp/st/stsgser_e768_html/ser768E.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
